rules: PASS is a validator result, not a standalone product maturity state.
A build result cannot establish DATA_BOUND.
A static page cannot establish PREVIEW_DEPLOYED.
PUBLIC_ALIGNED is forbidden when the deployed commit identity cannot be confirmed.

states.SPEC_APPROVED: A product or technical specification was explicitly approved; implementation is not implied.
states.FOUNDATION_CANDIDATE: A reusable foundation exists and has evidence, but it is not yet the sole route-bound implementation.
states.ARCHIVED: A historical implementation or evidence set is retained and is not the active product track.
states.DATA_E2E_PASS: Real source data passed the declared end-to-end data reconciliation gate.
states.LOCAL_PREVIEW_READY: A local preview can be opened; real data binding and business E2E are not implied.
states.STATIC_SHELL: Routes and presentation components render with static or placeholder data only.
states.DATA_BOUND: The declared canonical adapter/view model supplies real data through the full route boundary.
states.HOME_VERTICAL_SLICE_LOCAL_E2E_PASS: Only /v2/home is data-bound and has passed the declared real-data browser E2E; the remaining V2 routes stay static and visual acceptance is not implied.
states.LOCAL_E2E_PASS: The data-bound local workflow passed browser interaction and restore checks.
states.VISUAL_ACCEPTED: The full page was compared against its approved references and accepted visually.
states.PREVIEW_DEPLOYED: A preview environment was deployed from an identified clean commit and is reachable.
states.HUMAN_ACCEPTED: A human explicitly accepted the declared scope after reviewing the real artifact.
states.PUBLIC_ALIGNED: The public runtime is healthy and its deployed commit, schema, and UI version are identified and aligned.
states.PUBLIC_HEALTH_PASS_COMMIT_UNKNOWN: The public runtime is healthy, but the deployed Git commit cannot be proven.
states.READY_FOR_USER_AUTHORIZATION: A single next task contract exists but execution has not been authorized or started.
states.NOT_REVERIFIED_THIS_RUN: Earlier evidence exists, but the relevant gate was not rerun in the current execution.
states.BLOCKED: A declared hard gate failed and execution must stop.
states.SUPERSEDED: A previous task or state record was replaced by a named newer authority.
